# Finding ourselves in the future

<p class="speaker-detail-byline">Speaker: Bill Sharpe, Future Stewards</p>
:::

::: {.speaker-detail-grid}
::: {.content-card}
## Summary

How are we to act in the face of existential risks? How can we meet the uncertainty and complexity of the future with hope? If we are all to live well and thrive on one planet, profound changes in our ways of life will be required.

This talk introduces Three Horizons, a simple but powerful futures practice that helps people see patterns of life, understand their role in sustaining or changing them, and convene conversations for transformative action. It focuses on how futures practice can cultivate hope, agency, and future consciousness in practical settings.
:::

::: {.content-card}
## Speaker Bio

Bill Sharpe is a futures practitioner and systems thinker specialising in the intersection of science, technology, and society. After a career of innovation in the computer industry, he turned his attention to helping organisations meet the challenges of a complex and uncertain future.

He is known for pioneering the Three Horizons futures practice and is the author of *Three Horizons: The Patterning of Hope*. He is also a co-founder of [Future Stewards](http://www.futurestewards.com/), which works to build regenerative futures where all life can flourish within the means of the planet.
:::
